dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something seems to be troubling you.

dialogues.speaker: Matsukawa Souzen
dialogues.text: Inazuma has just gone through a series of changes. A new era is coming.

dialogues.speaker: Matsukawa Souzen
dialogues.text: To be honest, all this has made me too busy to have time for anything else, but I don't think that this is a bad thing, necessarily.

dialogues.speaker: Matsukawa Souzen
dialogues.text: Her Excellency has seems to have had something of a change of mood. I can only hope that...

dialogues.speaker: Matsukawa Souzen
dialogues.text: Ah, I shall not speak of this now. Whatever the case, our work in clearing our accounts is far busier than usual. Perhaps we can chat again some other time.
